narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Round to the nearest hundred, so seven hundred sweets are enough.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But seven hundred is less than the number of people.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Thirty two people would get no sweet, so the slip is struck out.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Ask what the situation needs before rounding.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Round up to be safe, and round down to be careful.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Either way can do when it does not matter, but money must not be rounded.
<bookmark mark='m4'/>Your turn. A bus holds fifty. How many buses carry four hundred eighteen people?
